items.title: Define Experience Layer leaf types and a minimal learning-store that reads/writes .lattice/learning/ with zero outward imports
items.context: core/experience-layer-types.ts (FindingSignal/LearningSignal/derived-cache types) + core/learning-store.ts (ensure .lattice/learning dir; read/write finding-signals.json). Only node:, ./, ../ imports within the module; never ../../ out of the module.
items.userSees: Build is clean; the new modules exist and the smoke asserts the learning-store round-trips finding-signals.json and that the module set has zero cross-module imports.

items.title: Implement finding-signals derivation reading findings through store.readFindings (port), not raw findings.json
items.context: core/finding-signals.ts: aggregate findings by localSignature = category + signatureTag? + fileKind + lifecyclePhase; compute counts, signalScore = positive/(positive+negative+1), support; write the derived cache. Read findings via the finding subsystem accessor store.readFindings, never JSON.parse of findings.json.
items.userSees: The smoke seeds findings via the store and asserts finding-signals.json contains the aggregated signals with correct signalScore/support and that derivation used the store accessor.

items.title: Register the derived cache and learning log as materialHash-excluded runtime artifacts (gate-safety)
items.context: runtime-artifact-registry.ts: add entries for .lattice/learning/finding-signals.json and .lattice/learning/learning-log.jsonl as materialHash:exclude, volatile:true, repairable. This is the load-bearing gate-safety lever.
items.userSees: The smoke asserts that writing finding-signals.json leaves currentMaterialHash() unchanged (the derived cache is excluded from gate material hashing).
